# IMToken
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/moonwell/IMToken.sol)

**Title:**
IMToken

Minimal interface for a Moonwell/Compound-style market token (mToken)


## Functions
### mint

User Interface **

Supplies underlying to the market and mints mTokens to the caller


```solidity
function mint(uint256 mintAmount) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`mintAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying to supply|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|An error code (0 on success)|


### mintWithPermit

Supplies underlying using an EIP-2612 permit to approve the transfer


```solidity
function mintWithPermit(uint256 mintAmount, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
    external
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`mintAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying to supply|
|`deadline`|`uint256`|The permit deadline|
|`v`|`uint8`|The permit signature v component|
|`r`|`bytes32`|The permit signature r component|
|`s`|`bytes32`|The permit signature s component|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|An error code (0 on success)|
